title: Patch: a daily sweep fuses each triggered card's text onto Units and plays it until the board settles
thread:
**Issue #2381 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2381: Patch: a daily sweep fuses each triggered card's text onto Units and plays it until the board settles
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some of the worst bugs this month came from one card fused into another: a unit carrying another card's death or end-of-turn text. They produced a game that never ended, a board that never settled, and a crash. The random test games only meet a given pair by luck, so these bugs reached the daily runs or the AI's own sweeps first. Once this is built, a test goes through these combinations on purpose every day, with a small slice on every pull request, so this kind of bug is caught before a player meets it.

## Why

Fusion bugs that got past the per-PR fuzz:

- #1562 (`b3b8120de`, R1121000): a fused Book of Stats and Autocomplete replayed without end in one turn.
- #998 (`2cbf0a17b`): a fusion grew to 288 cards, and fuzz seed 8286 ran out of memory.
- #2243 (`9bfd8aebb`), from the daily waves after Stinkyscape shipped:
  - Wormhole's text fused onto a Unit kept games from ending (R1884003);
  - a fused Job Application at 0 health never settled (R1884004);
  - a fused copier's targeting cost panicked (R1850000).
- #2356 (`381c255cc`, R2197005): Floodgates and Job Application fused, and "the board did not settle". The AI sweep `sweep:hard:traininggrounds-014:6` found it, not the fuzz.
- `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md:238-241` records two earlier ones, #104 and #105.

The fuzz's only deliberate fusion is one random pair of Units on a manufactured last board (`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs:505-529`). Games read that board only through the few cards that bring one back.

## Proposal

- A test that enumerates pairs:
  - a body from the fusable Units (no token, no Immutable: `FUSABLE_UNITS`' rule);
  - a text from every card whose script has a Death, a trigger, a start- or end-of-turn hook, an aura or a fused hook, Field Spells and Traps included, since Wormhole and Job Application are no Units.
- For each pair:
  - build the fused card on a seat's board with `craft_fused` (`crates/cards/tests/cross/mod.rs:24`);
  - run a fixed script: destroy it, have each side cast a Spell, end turns;
  - then play a short random-policy run seeded from the pair, under `create_invariant_monitor` (`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs:1571`).
- It fails on a panic, an engine cap, an invariant breach or a step bound, and names both card ids and the seed.
- The whole enumeration runs daily (`#[ignore = "daily: …"]`). A fixed stride sample runs on every pull request, so a cheaper test keeps the rule.
- A known-open list, each entry citing an open issue, may only shrink (the policy `POOL_EXCLUSIONS` follows).

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/tests/cross/fused_pairs.rs` and `mod.rs`. `crates/tools` beside the fuzz is the alternative if it needs the fuzz's growth bounds.
- `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` and the crate's README test list.
- SPEC §10 (fusion), R179 and R874000.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The daily test walks every pair and prints how many it played. The per-PR sample stays within the `rust` job's budget.
- [ ] #2356's pair and R1884004's pair are pinned cases and pass.
- [ ] A planted fixture text that loops on its own death fails the sweep, with both ids and the seed in the message.
- [ ] A failure's message reproduces it with one command.
- [ ] Every known-open entry names an open issue.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 400 lines in 3 or 4 files, with no engine change.

- The daily runtime needs sharding across cores.
- The first full run may surface several loops, each needing its own fix or ruling. The PR lands the sweep with those on the known-open list rather than fixing them all.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `fuzz` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.
```
